metadata.notes: Parent species found via pokemon_species.evolves_from_species_id; conditions from pokemon_evolution.csv (ALL version-group rows included; rows differing only by location are merged into one, with every location listed in notes — e.g. Magnezone level-up lists all magnetic locations; rows differing in any other condition are kept as separate methods, e.g. Kubfu->Urshifu by tower-of-darkness, tower-of-waters and use-item scrolls; Glaceon/Leafeon by rock location or stone; Sylveon by affection or happiness). Trigger names are PokeAPI evolution_triggers identifiers (level-up, trade, use-item, shed, spin, tower-of-darkness, tower-of-waters, three-critical-hits, take-damage, in-battle-level-up, agile-style-move, strong-style-move, recoil-damage, use-move, three-defeated-bisharp, gimmighoul-coins, meltan-candies, unclassified). Trade evolutions are flagged trade=true with a note that PUW has no trading and must use a trade-replacement rule; no replacement rule is invented here. Extra conditions with no dedicated field (trade_species, needs_multiplayer, near_special_rock, minimum_affection, used_move, minimum_steps, minimum_move_count, minimum_damage_taken, condition_expression, gender, nature_bitmask, percentage_chance) are recorded in notes. relative_physical_stats: -1 means Attack < Defense, 0 means Attack = Defense, 1 means Attack > Defense.
